INSERT INTO lean_lemur.source_artifacts
(artifact_key,file_name,artifact_version,sha256,source_surface,source_ref,status,notes)
VALUES ('openscale_gdrive_auto_backup','openScale.db_auto_backup.zip','live','{{ $json.backup_sha256 }}','google_drive','1ORsO99FD7wN_doy5z-IZm-bpMFa73HqD','LIVE_SOURCE','Automatic openScale backup from Eufy T9120')
ON CONFLICT (artifact_key) DO UPDATE SET sha256=EXCLUDED.sha256, imported_at=now(), notes=EXCLUDED.notes;

INSERT INTO lean_lemur.scale_measurements
(measurement_key,source,source_record_id,measured_at_local,timezone,measured_at_utc,local_date,observation_kind,weight_kg,fat_mass_kg,bone_mass_kg,muscle_mass_kg,hydration_kg,bodyfat_pct_calculated,comments,source_artifact_key)
VALUES
('{{ $json.measurement_key }}','{{ $json.source }}','{{ $json.source_record_id }}',
(TIMESTAMPTZ '{{ $json.measured_at_iso }}' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila'),'Asia/Manila',
TIMESTAMPTZ '{{ $json.measured_at_iso }}',DATE '{{ $json.local_date }}','measured',
{{ $json.weight_kg }},{{ $json.fat_mass_kg ?? 'NULL' }},{{ $json.bone_kg ?? 'NULL' }},
{{ $json.muscle_mass_kg ?? 'NULL' }},{{ $json.hydration_kg ?? 'NULL' }},
{{ $json.bodyfat_pct ?? 'NULL' }},'{{ $json.comments.replaceAll("'", "''") }}','openscale_gdrive_auto_backup')
ON CONFLICT (measurement_key) DO UPDATE SET
weight_kg=EXCLUDED.weight_kg,fat_mass_kg=EXCLUDED.fat_mass_kg,bone_mass_kg=EXCLUDED.bone_mass_kg,
muscle_mass_kg=EXCLUDED.muscle_mass_kg,hydration_kg=EXCLUDED.hydration_kg,
bodyfat_pct_calculated=EXCLUDED.bodyfat_pct_calculated,comments=EXCLUDED.comments,imported_at=now()
RETURNING measurement_key,weight_kg,measured_at_utc;
